Implemented `outage_refund(payment, amount, at)` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Rounds the amount to cents and rejects non-positive amounts (`non_positive_amount`).
- Requires the payment to be `captured` (`invalid_state`).
- Validates `at` via `ensure_utc`.
- Adds to `refunded_amount`, rejecting totals exceeding the captured amount (`refund_exceeds_amount`).
- Sets status to `"refunded"` when fully refunded, and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, plus manual edge-case checks.
